2609.17376.title: Large Language Models Develop Belief State Geometry In-Context
2609.17376.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) trained on next-token prediction exhibit remarkable in-context learning (ICL) abilities, yet the representations that support ICL remain poorly understood. We consider such representations in a controlled setting: prompting LLMs with data emitted from hidden Markov models (HMMs) and probing for the corresponding belief state -- the posterior distribution over the HMM's hidden states given the observed token history. Across six open-source LLMs prompted with data from 40 HMMs selected for non-trivial belief structure, we find that belief states are linearly decodable from residual stream activations, with peak probe $R^2$-values from 0.83-0.99 across HMM and LLM combinations, ranging from early to late layers. To establish functional relevance, we intervene directly on the probe-identified subspace via patching and steering, resulting in downstream prediction quality on the order of the untampered model, while controls degrade performance substantially. Together, these results provide representation-level evidence that ICL in open-source LLMs approximates optimal Bayesian prediction over a context-inferred generative model. More broadly, our findings extend prior results linking input-distribution structure to activation geometry: from toy networks trained explicitly on HMM data to production-scale LLMs.
2609.17376.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在下一個標記預測的訓練中展現出卓越的上下文學習（ICL）能力，但支持ICL的表示仍然不甚了解。我們在一個受控的環境中考慮這些表示：用隱馬爾可夫模型（HMM）發出的數據來提示LLMs，並探測相應的信念狀態——在觀察到的標記歷史下，HMM隱藏狀態的後驗分佈。在六個使用來自40個選擇的具有非平凡信念結構的HMM數據的開源LLMs中，我們發現信念狀態可以從殘差流激活中線性解碼，峰值探測$R^2$值在0.83到0.99之間，涵蓋了HMM和LLM的組合，從早期層到晚期層。為了建立功能相關性，我們通過修補和引導直接介入探測識別的子空間，導致下游預測質量接近未經篡改的模型，而控制組則顯著降低性能。綜合這些結果，我們提供了表示層級的證據，表明開源LLMs中的ICL近似於對上下文推斷生成模型的最佳貝葉斯預測。更廣泛地說，我們的發現擴展了先前將輸入分佈結構與激活幾何聯繫起來的結果：從明確在HMM數據上訓練的玩具網絡到生產規模的LLMs。
